Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the reporting on certain surveys by the transportation commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to survey reporting by the transportationcommission; and amending RCW 47.60.286.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.60.286 and 2007 c 512 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission shall, with the involvement of the department,conduct a survey to gather data on ferry users to help inform level ofservice, operational, pricing, planning, and investment decisions. Thesurvey must include, but is not limited to: (a) Recreational use; (b) Walkon customer use; (c) Vehicle customer use; (d) Freight and goods movement demand; and (e) Reactions to potential operational strategies and pricingpolicies described under RCW 47.60.327 and 47.60.290. (2) The commission shall develop the survey after providing anopportunity for ferry advisory committees to offer input. (3) The survey must be updated at least every two years and p. 1 SB 6528maintained to support the development and implementation of adaptivemanagement of ferry services. (4) At the beginning of each biennium, the commission must reportto the legislature on the surveys conducted pursuant to this chapterand the cost of conducting such surveys.
